project.name: endurance-multisport-telemetry
project.description: High-contrast dark mobile telemetry app for endurance athletes and coaches to track live biometrics and execute multi-phase workouts.
project.target: React Native (Expo) with TypeScript, functional components and hooks, React Navigation (bottom tabs + stack)

skills.name: react-architect
skills.reason: Structural decisions for the React Native blackboard architecture

skills.name: react-ui
skills.reason: Flexbox layout and design system application

global_requirements.layout: SafeAreaView vertical flex column: top header banner, stack/tab navigator content area, bottom tab navigation (Dashboard, Routines, Profile); stack drill-down for workout detail and active execution

responsive.medium: row wrap of cards for tablet/landscape via useWindowDimensions

core_services: Biometric Telemetry Service — ingests live heart rate (bpm), power (watts), cadence (rpm) and training load streams so cards and gauges update in real time
Toast & Notification Store — shows banner alerts when heart rate or power exceeds target zones or intervals transition
Auth & Athlete Profile Store — manages athlete/coach session profile, user metrics and avatar media

shared_ui.name: athlete-header-banner
shared_ui.purpose: Top safe-area header with athlete avatar, title and quick sync actions
shared_ui.content: elements: avatar image, title 'ENDURANCE TELEMETRY', active sport indicator, quick sync action buttons; data: athlete profile; states: loading | success | error; interactions: tap sync, tap avatar; a11y: accessibilityRole header, buttons min 44x44pt with accessibilityLabel
shared_ui.a11y: Touch targets >= 44x44pt, accessibilityLabel on avatar and sync buttons

shared_ui.name: biometric-telemetry-cards
shared_ui.purpose: Icon-driven status cards for heart rate, power output and cadence
shared_ui.content: elements: heart icon card, lightning icon card, pedal/runner icon card, detail labels; data: BiometricMetric; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: tap for detail; a11y: accessibilityLabel with value and unit
shared_ui.a11y: Each card has accessibilityRole summary and accessibilityLabel with metric value

shared_ui.name: comparison-split-bars
shared_ui.purpose: Horizontal percentage split bars comparing training stress (e.g. 30/70 vs 50/50)
shared_ui.content: elements: dual horizontal split bars with category labels; data: TrainingRatio; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: none; a11y: accessibilityRole progressbar with accessibilityValue
shared_ui.a11y: accessibilityRole progressbar, accessibilityValue now/min/max for each split

shared_ui.name: radial-gauge-indicator
shared_ui.purpose: Dual circular progress rings showing target completion (e.g. 80% target load, 20% interval progress)
shared_ui.content: elements: two radial rings with centered metrics; data: completion percentages; states: loading | success | error; interactions: none; a11y: accessibilityValue and accessibilityLabel on each ring
shared_ui.a11y: accessibilityRole progressbar, accessibilityValue text with percentage, accessibilityState

shared_ui.name: horizontal-stepper-timeline
shared_ui.purpose: 4-stage horizontal arrow progress bar STEP 01 to STEP 04 for workout phases
shared_ui.content: elements: four chevron steps labeled STEP 01..STEP 04; data: PhaseProgress; states: PENDING | IN_PROGRESS | COMPLETED; interactions: tap step; a11y: accessibilityState selected/checked
shared_ui.a11y: Each step has accessibilityLabel and accessibilityState, 44pt touch target

shared_ui.name: interval-exercise-cards
shared_ui.purpose: Stacked vertical cards with sequential workout instructions and interval targets
shared_ui.content: elements: FlatList of step cards (STEP 01, STEP 02) with title, description, target zone, completion checkmark; data: WorkoutStep; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: tap to complete, haptic feedback; a11y: screen reader focusable cards
shared_ui.a11y: Focusable cards with accessibilityLabel; controls min 44x44pt

shared_ui.name: live-telemetry-statistics-bar
shared_ui.purpose: Dual-layered horizontal meter for real-time intensity output
shared_ui.content: elements: two layered horizontal meter bars; data: BiometricMetric live stream; states: loading | success | error; interactions: none; a11y: accessibilityValue

shared_ui.name: bottom-action-bar
shared_ui.purpose: Persistent bottom bar with workout controls in thumb zone
shared_ui.content: elements: primary action button, secondary controls; data: workout state; states: enabled | disabled; interactions: tap; a11y: accessibilityRole button
shared_ui.a11y: Buttons min 44x44pt with accessibilityLabel and accessibilityState disabled

shared_ui.name: toast-banner-host
shared_ui.purpose: Banner alerts for zone threshold overflow, sensor disconnect and interval transitions
shared_ui.content: elements: banner text, dismiss button; data: notification queue; states: hidden | visible; interactions: dismiss, auto-timeout; a11y: accessibilityLiveRegion polite
shared_ui.a11y: accessibilityLiveRegion assertive for alerts, dismiss button 44x44pt

features.name: dashboard
features.description: Performance telemetry dashboard: real-time athletic monitoring summary with athlete profile, live biometric streams, comparative training split ratios, circular completion rings, workout phase progress and exercise step lists. Vertical scroll with pull-to-refresh (RefreshControl); states loading | empty | error | success; banner toast on zone threshold overflow or sensor disconnect.

features.name: routines
features.description: Workout progression and routines: athletes view and track multi-phase sessions (STEP 01 to STEP 04) and execute step-by-step exercise and interval routines. Views list, detail and stepper; FlatList virtualized rendering, sticky bottom execution control bar, inline completion checkmarks, haptic feedback on interval completion, phase transition alerts; states loading | empty | error | success.
actions: Fetch workout steps by routine ID
